title: <hook>.json
description: One hook, in rbtv's format, read by the rbtv installer and translated into each harness's own hook settings. A harness without hooks receives none.

name.description: The hook's name, the same as its file name without `.json`.

description.description: One line that is enough to decide whether the hook is relevant.

event.description: The event that runs the hook, such as a tool use or the end of a turn; the installer translates it into each harness's own event.

matcher.description: Which tools or inputs the hook applies to, for events that take one. Absent means all.

command.description: The command the harness runs, such as a tool placed on PATH.

timeout.description: Seconds before the harness stops the command. Absent means the harness default.
